common_fixes.fix: Set wheelchair_accessible on every trip. If every vehicle is accessible, this may be one default; otherwise use the value for each trip.
Set wheelchair_boarding to 1 (accessible) or 2 (not accessible) for every stop. A field survey can start with the busiest stops.
Add fare_attributes.txt (or Fares v2 files) with your fare structure. If your service is fare-free, ask to have it marked fare-free instead.

comparison.note: Score aggregates and named changes use one current producer contract, raw reader archive profile, and measured-category set across canonical feed records, with unresolved duplicate identities removed. Absolute rankings and individual percentiles are not published.
